glosses: goods (that which is produced, traded, bought or sold)

examples.text: Mi padre me dejó algunos bienes.
examples.en: My father left me some property.

examples.text: La entrega de los bienes se retrasó a causa de la tormenta.
examples.en: The delivery of the goods was delayed due to the storm.

examples.text: La felicidad no consiste en tener solamente bienes materiales.
examples.en: Happiness isn't merely having many possessions.
